dedupe_keys.name: kincade fire highway routing extraction code

description: The EvacuationBehavior team publishes Python code used to extract highway routes for the Kincade Fire evacuation dataset. The public GitHub repository is MIT licensed and its README names pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Contextily and GeoPandas plus a synthetic GPS demonstration file. The workflow can prepare route observations for traffic or emergency-response simulations without distributing identified raw traces. The published example covers Sonoma County, California. A caveat is that the demo CSV is synthetic; reproducing the published Sonoma County route table requires the appropriate source location data and cleaning assumptions. The code prepares observed routes and is not itself an evacuation traffic simulator. Its output dataset has a separate DesignSafe DOI. I read the own repository metadata and README and the article code statement without cloning the code, running Python dependencies, downloading routes or checking location privacy. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
